name: Voice Inbox
description: Voice notes that file and find themselves, on your GPU

paragraphs: Say a note to yourself ("remind me to call the dentist tomorrow", "add oat milk to the list", "text mom I'll be late") and it files itself into Reminders, Lists, Messages, Travel, Questions or Music, with a ⏰ badge when it mentions a time. Liquid AI's d1-omni-600M sorts each note in your browser on WebGPU: two typed questions over the clip, one forward pass each, with no transcript and nothing generated. Your voice never leaves the page. Notes are kept in this browser's storage only.
Model: LiquidAI/d1-omni-600M (LFM Open License v1.0), converted to ONNX at onnx-community/d1-omni-600M-ONNX. The example notes are synthetic voices made with Kokoro.

About 160 ms to sort a note on an M3 Pro (the audio encoder, plus one pass per question), and well under 100 ms to embed a search.
